plan.notes: Reviewed xtask/src/main.rs for CLI definitions, helper utilities, and cbd subcommand handlers; captured the requested target module layout and invariants.
Drafted contract clauses for module layout, CLI surface, and validate-ready/verify exit code behavior; added acceptance tests and mapped clause ids to build/test work items.

- XT-INV-001 should clarify whether Clap default flags (--help/--version) are excluded or explicitly allowed; current "only" wording likely too strict for metadata-based tests.
- VR-ERR-003/VFY-ERR-003/VFY-ERR-004 responses are vague; tighten to the exact multi-line outputs in xtask/src/main.rs so acceptance tests can be checkable.
- VFY-ERR-002 bundles multiple failure modes (invalid JSON, invalid clause ids, invalid acceptance_tests.proves, evidence mismatch); consider splitting into explicit error codes or specify per-case message prefixes.
- Scope promises templates unchanged, but tests only compare outputs against templates; add a clause/test to lock template files or relax scope accordingly.
- Bundle artifact_paths.task points to missing .cbd/tasks/0002-xtask-modules-refactor.md; add a docs work item to create it or update artifact_paths if intentionally absent.
- WI-002 may be too large (CLI surface/help, structure/deps, scaffolding, validate-ready, verify); consider splitting by acceptance test groups for clearer proof ownership.

- Clarified XT-INV-001 to allow clap default flags and tightened validate-ready/verify error outputs to exact message prefixes.
- Expanded VFY-ERR-002/VFY-ERR-004 responses and updated acceptance test descriptions to match real outputs.
- Narrowed scope to template-driven outputs and added a template-change assumption.
- Split the test work item into focused items and added a docs work item for the missing task seed.

build.description: Refactor xtask into modules: move clap CLI definitions to cli.rs, cbd dispatch/handlers to cbd/*, and shared helpers to util/* while keeping main.rs minimal.
Add CLI surface and help-output tests for cbd subcommands (help exits 0; flags/args match contract).
Add module layout and dependency list tests (main.rs minimal, cli.rs types, cbd/* handlers, util modules, Cargo.toml deps).
Add scaffolding tests for interactive and non-interactive flows against templates.
Add validate-ready exit-code/output tests for missing/invalid/not-ready/ready cases.
Add verify exit-code/output tests for missing artifacts, invalid JSON/schema cases, readiness gate, coverage gaps, checks failing, and success.
Create task seed .cbd/tasks/0002-xtask-modules-refactor.md with scope/context aligned to the contract (or update artifact_paths.task if intentionally absent).
Run `xtask cbd verify --id 0002` and update evidence.json with proof locations.
Package a review archive and request a second-pass review (e.g., GPT-5.2 Pro).
